questions.q_en: Pradeep, Nikku, Rinku, Sohail and Tannu are sitting on a bench facing north, Pradeep is immediate neighbour of Nikku. Sohail is immediate neighbour of Tannu, Pradeep is not sitting with Rinku who sits on the right end of the bench. Pradeep sits to the right of Sohail and Tannu. Sohail sits to the right of Tannu. In which position Pradeep is sitting?
questions.solution_en:
Pradeep is not sitting with Rinku who sits on the right end of the bench. Pradeep sits to the right of Sohail and Tannu.

Pradeep is immediate neighbour of Nikku. Sohail is immediate neighbour of Tannu. Sohail sits to the right of Tannu. So, case 1 is eliminated.

Hence, Pradeep is sitting third from the left and also third from the right end of the row.

questions.q_en: Seven boys J, K, L, M, N, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). P is second to the right of Q. M is the immediate neighbour of both J and Q. L is not the immediate neighbour of Q. N is second to the right of P. Who is to immediate left of L?
questions.solution_en:
P is second to the right of Q.

M is the immediate neighbour of both J and Q.

N is second to the right of P.

L is not the immediate neighbour of Q.

So, we are left with only one place to sit for K.

Hence, the person sitting to immediate left of L is P.

questions.q_en: All 47 students of a class are standing in a row facing north. Mohit is 19th from the right end while Palak is 8th from the left end. How many people are standing between Mohit and Palak?
questions.solution_en:
Total number of students standing = 47

Position of Mohit + Position of Palak = 19+8=27

Number of people standing between Mohit and Palak = 47-27=20

So, twenty people are standing between Mohit and Palak.

questions.q_en: Find the mirror image of the clock when the time is 10:28.
questions.solution_en:

11:60 - 10:28 = 1:32

Thus, mirror image of 10:28 is 1:32.

questions.q_en: In a certain code language, 'BRAVE' is written as 'AQBUF' and 'DREAM' is written as 'CQFBL'. How will 'GRAPE' be written in that language?
questions.solution_en:
According to the alphabetical series, the consonants are replaced by the previous letter, and the vowels are replaced immediately after.

B ----- B - 1 = A

R ----- R - 1 = Q

A ----- A + 1 = B

V ----- V - 1 = U

E ----- E + 1 = F

D ----- D - 1 = C

R ----- R - 1 = Q

E ----- E + 1 = F

A ----- A + 1 = B

M ----- M - 1 = L

So,

G ----- G - 1 = F

R ----- R - 1 = Q

A ----- A + 1 = B

P ----- P - 1 = O

E ----- E + 1 = F

So, 'GRAPE' will be written in that language as 'FQBOF'.

You have to examine these two statements carefully and decide if the Assertion (A) and the Reason (R) are individually true and if so, whether the Reason (R) is a correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

Assertion (A): The Dead Sea's unusually high salt concentration means that people can easily float in the Dead Sea.

Reason (R): Our body's weight is lighter than the density of the water in the Dead Sea, and our body is more buoyant in the Dead Sea.
options_en: Both A and R are true and R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
A is true and R is false.
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
A is false and R is true.

Human can float in the Dead Sea is definitely true.

The Dead Sea has the high concentration of Salt due to which the density of the Dead Sea is higher than the density of a human body. So, our body is more buoyant in the Dead Sea. So, both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
